description: 1 mm plain photo blanks for UV printing. The photo face prints against smooth PEI.
changelog: 2026-10-13  process.bottom_shell_layers: 3 -> 5  (1 mm = 5 layers at 0.2 mm; with the preset's 5 top layers the blank prints fully solid)
2026-10-13  bed_type: High Temp Plate = Bambu smooth PEI plate (flat, smooth photo face)
2026-10-13  note: preset already uses monotonic bottom surface, 0.15 elephant-foot compensation, no skirt
2026-10-13  ams_color: FFFFFF  (blanks print in white; printer picks the AMS slot holding white)
2026-10-13  model: label deboss 0.4 -> 0.2 mm (one layer; first test print's label was deeper than wanted). Keep layer_height 0.2 so the label is exactly the top layer.
2026-10-14  model: label removed (storage trays carry the size; plain blanks diffuse light evenly). Label cuts suppressed in Fusion, LABELS=False in photo_blanks.py.

2026-10-16  start_purge_extra_mm: 250  (white blanks: the bed-side first layer is the UV-print face, so any black left in the nozzle from an earlier print shows; user asked to always purge more before white. Stock start purge 105 mm, now 355 mm, ~850 mm3)
